changes: Added a macOS arm64 packaging script for DMG/ZIP builds.
Added a share ZIP that bundles release notes, manifest and SHA256 checksums.
Updated the GitHub Release workflow to use the macOS share packager.
Configured the app update feed for the public GitHub project.
known_risks: macOS builds still require a Mac or GitHub Actions macOS runner.
The macOS alpha build remains unsigned and not notarized, so first launch may require manual approval in macOS Gatekeeper.
The bundled Python runtime can make macOS artifacts large.
